create_lm_min_lstm_model: create a LMMinLSTM language model with token embeddings and configurable weight tying
build_min_lstm_args_config: build a LMMinLSTMArgs dataclass to configure vocab size, seed, and loss reduction settings
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on token values through the LMMinLSTM model to get logits or loss
reset_model_parameters: reset LMMinLSTM model parameters using truncated normal initialization with configurable standard deviation
get_no_recompute_ops: get the set of torch operations excluded from gradient checkpointing recomputation
